note: Correlating a field against prose the sim renders FROM that field is circular, and it looks exactly like evidence. The Grain nearly shipped a change banding room water from regime.micro.wetness, justified by wetness above zero separating the locale descriptor_noun 3-of-3 and 5-of-5 across eight sampled rooms. But grammar-render takes micro as an argument, so descriptor_noun IS a function of wetness. The measurement was a definition. Caught only by reading micro.rs, whose module doc then also killed the mechanism outright: micro_field draws four sub-streams of LOCALE_MICRO from the room ADDRESS NOISE and has no coupling to terrain, so banding water from it would scatter river rooms as salt-and-pepper. Rule of thumb: before treating a field as evidence for a claim, grep for what CONSUMES it, and if the thing you are correlating against is downstream of it, you have measured plumbing.
